svg.title: Time estimates in hours, with remaining against logged — SoftTrack web design mockup (#268)
svg.desc: An estimate is points and time logged is minutes, and nothing relates the two. An optional time estimate on a ticket shows logged against estimated with what remains, logging time asks how much is left, a sprint and an epic add the three up, and a team chooses points, hours or both.
